name: Ops Core Pack
description: The shared operations foundation: infrastructure as code, CI/CD automation, observability, and security hardening. Composed by the SRE and platform engineer packs; installable on its own for a minimal ops baseline.
useCases: Give a coding agent the baseline ops skills shared by SRE and platform work: IaC, CI/CD, observability, and hardening.
Start from a minimal operations foundation and layer persona packs on top.
examplePrompts: Write Terraform for this service and a CI pipeline that plans and applies it safely.
Add the logging, metrics, and alerts this service needs before it takes production traffic.
